#  13344 - Renewable Energies - Materials, Components, Function Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13344 - module is no longer offered from SS 2010**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Renewable Energies - Materials, Components, Function**  |  
|  Erneuerbare Energien - Materialien, Komponenten, Funktion   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Natural Sciences and Computer Science   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.rer.nat. Scheffler, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Basic knowledge of renewable energy conversion components/statistics, fundamentals and definitions; chemical and physical knowledge of the working principles; technical limits and economical importance of several systems. The topic of the module serves as an example to illustrate the connection between basic and applied science andto demonstrate the methods of attaining new perceptions. Additionally the module supports social competences as the capacity for teamwork and further competences as accurateness, endurance, and curiosity.  |  
| Contents:  | Lecture: statistics in energy consumption, kinds of energy ressources and definitions; photovoltaics; solar thermal; wind, water and planetary energy; fuel cells; geothermal; biomassPractical course: basic experiments in order to evaluate RE technology and to learn about the energy content of energy ressources; excursion to manufacturers  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | basics in chemistry and physics  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | will be given during the course or communicated via the department´s homepage (www.tu-cottbus.de/ceramics)  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Written examination à 90 minutes at the end of semester and successful performance in the practical course.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Vorlesung: Prof. SchefflerPraktikum: Frau Dr. Wilker, Hr. Kappa, wiss. HKModul im Vertiefungsfach "Angewandte Physik" des Master-Studiengangs Physik  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
